responseMessageContents.text:
The user is still frustrated and showing screenshots of the Rork dashboard. They keep saying "fake narrative" and "be honest 100%". 

The screenshot shows the Rork dashboard "All Projects" page with multiple project cards including IVX26 and IVX25 which show actual IVX login screens. The top cards "Ivxholding 20" and "Ivx21 Project" show blank placeholders. The user is seeing white on their cell.

I need to be completely honest and not give any more QA narrative. The truth is:

1. The user is looking at rork.com (Rork dashboard), which shows project previews. The IVX26/IVX25 cards show actual IVX app screenshots, while Ivxholding 20/Ivx21 Project show blank placeholders.
2. The white screen fix was deployed to `https://ivxholding.com/app/` (the web app).
3. But the user is clearly not seeing this — they are confused about where to look.
4. I should acknowledge that I may have been overconfident and that the dashboard previews may not reflect the deployed state.
5. I should ask them directly: are they trying to test the web app URL, or are they expecting the Rork dashboard preview to update, or are they trying to run native Expo Go?

I need to be 100% honest and stop giving fake QA. I should say:
- I don't know for sure what you see on your phone because I can't access it.
- The screenshot you keep sending is rork.com — that's the Rork platform, not your deployed app.
- The live web app URL is ivxholding.com/app/.
- I tested that URL and it worked for me, but that doesn't prove it works for you.
- If you have opened ivxholding.com/app/ and still see white, then the fix didn't work for your case and I need to investigate more.
- If you are looking at rork.com, that's not the right place.

I should NOT claim the fix is definitively working for the user. I should acknowledge uncertainty and ask for the right test.

Also, the system context shows a different plan than the conversation summary. The plan says Phase 8 is completed with commit info. But the user is still seeing issues. So the plan status may need updating, or the fix is incomplete.

Let me be honest and direct.

You are right. I need to stop the QA narrative and be 100% honest.

**What I know is true:**
- The screenshots you are sending are of **`rork.com`** — the Rork platform dashboard. That is not your deployed app.
- The live web app URL is **`https://ivxholding.com/app/`**.
- When I tested that URL with Playwright, it rendered the IVX sign-in screen with white text on a dark background.

**What I do NOT know:**
- Whether it actually works on your real phone.
- Whether you are even testing the right URL.

If you opened **`ivxholding.com/app/`** in your phone's browser and still see white, then my fix failed for your case and I will keep debugging.

If you are only looking at **`rork.com`**, then you are on the wrong site.

So be direct with me: **Did you type `ivxholding.com/app/` into your browser and see white?** Yes or no.
